project.name: OxiGuitar
project.description: Free, open-source fully modular guitar tablature and score viewer, editor and player for Windows, macOS and Linux. Written entirely in Rust. Supports Guitar Pro 3-8, MuseScore, MusicXML, ABC and MIDI file formats via a plugin architecture. Features standard notation and tablature display, playback with SoundFont synthesis and Neural Amp Modeler support, and PDF/PNG export.

frameworks.name: tiny-skia
frameworks.purpose: 2D pixel rendering (screen output, PNG, visual regression tests)

frameworks.name: winit
frameworks.purpose: Windowing system integration (via Slint transitive dependency)

core.description: Core data model for guitar tablature and score

core.name: oxiguitar-formats
core.description: File format parsing (Guitar Pro 3-8, MusicXML, ABC, MIDI)

core.name: oxiguitar-render
core.description: Rendering to pixels, PNG, and PDF

core.name: oxiguitar-play
core.description: Playback engine with lock-free audio queues

plugins.architecture: Every file format, tool, and output method is a plugin
